steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...The match started already.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I've got to... mm?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Wait, why is my sword here?

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Ah, Miss Maria brought it over earlier.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: She said she already gave it some adjustments, too. She guarantees it should be like new.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Byah—!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Mm... light and limber. I've missed this feeling.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: P-Please be careful! Oh, my, you've broken the balustrade again! We just had the stonesmith repair that in the Victorian style last year...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Oh, you may as well just have someone renovate the whole place. In fact, you're in charge of that.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Really, another one of your whims?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: As long as someone can live in it...

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Miss?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Ah, no, I just... feel like I miss something, suddenly.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: This sword... Maria's grandfather gave it to me.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Miss Maria calls you an aunt, doesn't she?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Family hierarchy is one unending wordy mess. I still remember how Margaret put it—'This is your... your... you know what, she's your auntie.'

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'm only about as old as them, aren't I? Really—auntie?

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: You're very young. So young, and managing such a family enterprise. We take great pride in you, Miss Zofia.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I snapped up all this land in one breath. Oh, back then, was I thinking I'd prove myself as well? Prove myself worthy of the 'Nearl' name, maybe? Worthy of the Radiant Knight...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No... now's no time to pine for the past.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: The car is all ready for you. Or do you think running there yourself might be faster?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I think that's obvious—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Just like a hunter toying with his prey, the Left-hand Knight keeps letting his foe gather herself and try again, and each time, he strikes Maria Nearl back down!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Marcin! We're back! How's it going?!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Why's Maria up against someone at that goddamned level? Has the Association gone mad?!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: That'll be a long story... Are those kids safe?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: For the moment, can say that much. But they already got legal knighthood stripped right off them. Pfeh.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Never thought I'd see things get so goddarned out of hand...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Ashlock, Flametail, two other Infected knights without titles, and all the Infected they bought back from the arenas using everything they had...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Fighters! And the people toying with those Infected for fun—for god's sakes, they're all children! Their oldest was only twenty! Youngest was barely—!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Even if they hid themselves in the pipelines, just one full day in city bounds and their safety'd be out the window. Not to mention the crowd we have now.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I got some old friends to look after them, but the Infected are Infected, still. Wish things'd be simple as that.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: ...We're not just picking a fight with the companies, now.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Scared?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Scared?! Wasn't even scared when the Ursus were holding spears to my mouth! I'm a goddamned Ursus myself!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Fiddlesticks! When'd the Craftsmen ever get off those city walls?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Huh?! Instead of running up there, you think we should've just sat in the smithy and let the catapult smash all of us flat too?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...Maria can't win this.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Aye. The Maria we know facing a foe like that, just ain't no way she'll win.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: No, not that there's no way. I mean she just can't.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Knights Association have played their hand too hard now. Add in that rotten Czarny popping up, and there's no way it can go ahead that simple.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Nnh...!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (My... my arm's about to dislocate... his spear—I can't get close at all—)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (—No, even if I did, there's still no way I'd win... what do I do...?)

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Continue.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Grit my teeth, and get up.) Nngh...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: On the verge of toppling? You really are the image of your 'family knighthood,' struggling for breath.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Up. Continue. The best way to stamp out a knight is to stamp out her dignity.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: He taunts! He taunts, over and over! A look of disdain and victory in one, aimed square at his opponent! 'Left-hand' Tytus will make your blood run cold!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Now the prize pool's leaning completely one way, and the odds and figures are both out of control! Don't blink, but the money right now's gotta be on par with every other arena in Kazimierz combined!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Hey! Give it all you've got, Nearl! If you pull it outta the bag somehow, I'll win enough to buy a whole castle!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Are you nuts? How much money did you put on her?

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: —I put down even more on Left-hand! But I'm making nothing the way this is going, so I'm just hedging my bets a little!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hgghh... hah... hah...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: A visionary without a vision... wants to be a knight too.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: I won't kill you. Forfeit. The times of old will not fade for having done so. Abandon this, and you abandon only yourself.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Are you... sympathizing with me?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: —Correct. As you do not deserve for me to treat you as a knight.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: I've seen footage of your fights. From Szewczyk, through the race, the melee...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: I went out of my way to observe 'the Nearl family's new knight,' and every lucky victory of yours was a personal affront to me—look at you. You had the gall to waste my time like this?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ughh—!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Stand firm, Maria Nearl. I will tell you the worlds that separate you and the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Her shining light could drown her opponent's will. Her sheer passion made me tremble. Her sheer talent made others envy her.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: And you—victory against you is trivial. I will extinguish your resolve, to a pile of ash.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Airtime! Tytus has once against sent Maria's weapon flying!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Oh, man, this loop of devastation is too much bear, but no problem! The arena isn't just to let flesh and blood fly—it lets knights go on a rampage of pure strength!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Taunting! Pressuring! Destroying! This is 'Left-hand' Tytus, mercilessly disposing of the weak!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (So forceful...! And my shield split apart?! This is the one Margaret left!)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Traces of Arts on the edge of his blade—his Arts—)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: The Radiant Knight had not the Black Knight's strength, nor the Blood Knight's menace. She went against the lowest tier of the Major, and became champion by no more than a fluke—

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: —Even if I console myself so, I still know deeply the chasm that separated us. Against her, I have only pity for you, seeing your weakness.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I might not... compare to my sister...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But I am still—a Nearl family knight!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: ...Eyesore.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (One flick of his hand—?!)

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Enough! Insult me no longer with the Arts you used on Ingra!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ungh... ugh...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Do not rise again. No matter your armor's resilience, your pain must be excruciating.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You silently raise your arm again. Your tenacity at least deserves recognition.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Sorry, sorry—make way, make way!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I can finally see her...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Maria.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: What now? You have not even the energy to speak?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Your breaths come wild, your stance is empty... what path to victory could you even speak of?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: What—mnph.
The noble knight, the commercial leviathan, the veteran of the Major, Tytus Topola, once more narrows his eyes—
—to the light that pierces them.
